English.Char_Desc_450: ShortGeek turns a script you write or paste in into a finished vertical short: narrated, captioned and rendered on your own machine. English.Char_Desc_2000:
ShortGeek turns a script into a narrated, captioned vertical short.
Write or paste a script, split into a hook, a few beats and a call to action. ShortGeek reads it aloud, times captions to the words, builds the visuals and renders a 1080x1920 MP4 ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Attach a small screenshot to any beat, for example a Windows dialog, and it shows as an inset on that beat's card.
Backgrounds are drawn in code or are clips you supply. None of it is AI generated imagery.
The default voice is Microsoft Edge's free neural voice, which sends the narration text to Microsoft's online speech service. You can add your own ElevenLabs key, or use the offline voice, which sends nothing. Full privacy details: https://techygeekshome.info/shortgeek/privacy/
No account, no sign-up, no telemetry, no watermark and no export limit. It never uploads your videos and never posts on your behalf. Python and ffmpeg are inside the installer, so there is nothing to install first.
